caption: The drawing features a headless, armless figure wearing period clothing consisting of a deep red, velvet jacket with visible floral embroidery and trimmed with white lace at the collar and cuffs. The jacket is paired with dark green, velvet knee-length trousers that are embroidered with a matching floral pattern down the sides and lined with decorative buttons near the lower cuffs. The background is plain and unadorned, with the focus solely placed on the clothing, which appears to be suspended or positioned without a body, as no other body parts or objects are visible. title: Boy's Suit
